entities.summary: Mohammed Hardi Tufeiru is a Ghanaian politician and member of the Seventh Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana representing the Nanton Constituency in the Northern Region on the ticket of the New Patriotic Party. He is an academician and accountant, from the Institute of Chartered Accountant (ICAG) and holds MBA in Accounting from the University of Ghana and a Bachelor of Commerce degree from University of Cape Coast. He is currently the Deputy Minister of Agriculture.
